preconditions.description: The length of string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S) and all(c.islower() for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in strings S and P must be lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) >= len(P) and all(c in stdout for c in P))
postconditions.description: The output must be '-1' if no valid window exists, or a substring of S containing all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == min(len(window) for window in valid_windows)
postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest window containing all characters of P.
If multiple windows of the same length exist, the output must be the one with the least starting index.
